name: Richweed
desc: Richweed (Ageratina altissima): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 20 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ageratina altissima, also known as white snakeroot, richweed, or white sanicle, is a poisonous perennial herb in the family Asteraceae, native to eastern and central North America.
